verdict.rationale: Parse results come back in open, portable formats: markdown, text and JSON (docs-2, docs-25), structured JSON for extraction and forms (docs-13, docs-22), and tables as pandas DataFrames (docs-15). Lock-in is further reduced by self-hosted/BYOC deployment (docs-7, docs-28) and the option to connect your own vector database to Index (docs-30). However, nothing documents a bulk export of everything stored on the platform, so 'export all my data and leave' is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or account-level export of stored files, indexes, configurations and job history; a documented account and data deletion or offboarding process; independent corroboration of data portability.
